==Description==
The '''Gingerbread''' exclusively appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It had slightly more health than the [[Snowman (Village of Despair)|Snowman]] and moved faster than it. Upon the '''Gingerbread's''' death, the dynamite on its back exploded, stunning nearby towers.

The '''Gingerbread''' could be spawned by [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]].

==Appearance==
The '''Gingerbread''' was completely toasted brown, to resemble a gingerbread man. It had a circular head with red glowing eyes and three red dynamite sticks attached to its back. It had three white icing buttons lined vertically on the middle of its torso, as well as an iced smile.

==Strategy==
*The [[Pyromancer]] can burn the '''Gingerbread''', which slows it down.
**This can also be slowed down by the [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]].
*Try to kill this enemy away from towers to avoid them being stunned.
**Long-ranged towers like the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] are very effective at this, as their long range allows them to kill the '''Gingerbread''' from afar.
**Additionally, try to space out your towers so that not all of them are stunned once the '''Gingerbread''' is defeated.
*Later on during the game, the [[Medic]]'s ability can be used to cleanse towers that are stunned.

==Trivia==
*This enemy may be based on the [[w:c:r2da:Gingerbread Minion|Gingerbread Minion]] from R2DA.
*This was the first enemy that appeared in [[Village of Despair]] that could be affected by the [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]] as the [[Frozen (Village of Despair)|Frozen]] and [[Snowman (Village of Despair)|Snowman]] could not be frozen.
*The head that the '''Gingerbread''' used is the {{RLinkC|42588770|Gingerbread Man Head}} accessory from the Roblox catalog, except the eyes are retextured to be glowing red.
